## About
Dolphin Used Auto Parts is a family owned and operated business here in Miami. We carry quality late model used parts for foreign and domestic vehicles, and all our parts come from quality vehicles that are carefully chosen and have low mileage.
We work directly with insurance companies and adjusters, and we also deal with the general public and other shops and businesses. We keep a separate location just for storing parts and cars, so we have more inventory on hand for you.
As a recycler, we collect freon, oil, gasoline, antifreeze, plastics and metal to be recycled. Every part of a car is recyclable, and we are proud to do our part for our sensitive environment.

## Services
- Late model used parts: Quality late model used parts for foreign and domestic vehicles, including SUVs, cars, pickups and minivans.
- Engines, transmissions and airbags: An extensive list of engines, transmissions, airbags, differentials, and complete or partial interiors.
- OEM parts: We sell and guarantee original quality OEM parts.
- Cars For Sale: We carry export and rebuild title vehicles for sale. One out of town buyer said the whole process was smooth and everything was exactly how they said it was.
- Local and export shipping: We serve the United States, the Caribbean, and South and Central America, and can handle your shipping whether local or export.
- Insurance company and adjuster work: We work directly with insurance companies and adjusters.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you sell to the public or only to shops?
A: Both. We deal with the general public as well as other shops and businesses.

Q: Can you ship parts outside Florida?
A: Yes. We serve the United States, the Caribbean, and South and Central America, and handle shipping whether local or export.
